design_spaces.definition: Multivariate region in culture pH, temperature, duration and dissolved CO2 over which every cell-culture CQA is satisfied simultaneously.

source_references.quote: defining a robust design space in culture pH, temperature, duration and dissolved CO

statements.statement_text: Culture pH, temperature, dissolved CO2, osmolality and culture duration are classified WC-CPP.
The nominal fed-batch reaches a peak VCD of 13.48 x10^6 cells/mL and titer of 4.37 g/L.
All in-scope CQAs meet acceptance and a multivariate design space was established.
